ios.desc:
GrammarBot: your AI writing assistant. 

Elevate your written communication to the next level with GrammarBot! This AI writing assistant is your trusted companion for crafting flawless, engaging, and stylish content.

Key Features:

- Grammar Checks: Say goodbye to typos and grammar slip-ups. GrammarBot's powerful checks ensure your text is spotless.
- Message Rewrites: Seamlessly rephrase and enhance your messages, making them clearer and more impactful.
- Style Transformations: Transform your writing style to suit your mood or audience. From formal to casual, GrammarBot has it all.
- Expanded Language Support: Now enjoy using the app not only in English but also in Spanish, French, German, Ukrainian, Polish, and Norwegian.
- Translation Option: Seamlessly translate your text to various languages within the app.

Why Choose Grammar Bot?

    Boost your confidence in every message.
    Impress your readers with impeccable prose.
    Adapt your writing style effortlessly.

Unleash the power of Grammar Bot and make your words work wonders. Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who values the art of writing.

Download Grammar Bot now and unlock the true potential of your written expression!

show_hn.title: Show HN: GPT-powered grammar checker for better tweets

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I'm a solo developer from Ukraine, steadily growing my Twitter profile every day. 
I noticed I was caught in a repetitive cycle: writing a post, inputting it into Chat GPT, directing it to check the grammar, and manually selecting the necessary part...

That's why I created the GrammarBot app to help non-native speakers tweet more efficiently. It checks the grammar of your input messages and with just a click, it can rewrite or transform the writing style.

App link - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/grammarbot-write-like-a-pro/id6469009930

I would love to hear your feedback.

Best regards, Evhen
